notes.title: Update 0.7.2 - Camera
notes.content: The camera scrolling algorithm was changed. It tries to predict the direction of character movement to show more in this direction.

notes.title: Update with new graphic aesthetic
notes.content:
1. Let me present the new feature - the real-time glow of text characters. The glow consists of two blurs: 1/2 of symbol width and 3 x symbol width. This makes the game much more bright. However, it is possible to disable this feature in the options.

[previewyoutube=gVbpF97_PVE;full][/previewyoutube]

2. Another new feature is the 3d transformation of parallax text layers. When you move upstairs on the ladder for example you start to feel as you are looking up. This function can also be disabled in the settings.

[previewyoutube=7NgiRrzFLHU;full][/previewyoutube]

3. Several new visual effects were added such as plasma lightning.

4. Now the hero can squeeze into narrow passages.

5. Several bugs were fixed.

Thank you for your interest in ASCIIDENT!
